disclaimer: Role alignment maps confirmed skills and public repositories to target engineering roles. It is separate from employment history and deliberately omits synthetic fit scores or offer probabilities.

roles.title: Senior Java Backend Engineer
roles.summary: Core career focus since 2012 across enterprise Java (6–25), Spring Boot, JVM concurrency, SQL/PostgreSQL, JPA/Hibernate, and JUnit testing.

supportingEvidence.label: Kuehne+Nagel (May 2018 – Present): Senior Java Developer
Oracle (Jan 2014 – May 2017): SQE / Java Developer (JDK fixes & concurrency)
EntityLocker public Java keyed locking utility & JUnit 4 tests
JPA2 Spring/Hibernate 6 Maven project with CI

roles.limitations: Production Java codebases at Kuehne+Nagel and Oracle are proprietary; EntityLocker lacks a GitHub Actions CI workflow and its CountLock eviction path requires thread-safety hardening.
areasRequiringConfirmation: Depth with Java 21+ virtual threads vs classical thread-pool executors in production.
Team leadership, architecture ownership, and system scale parameters under NDA-safe interview discussion.
